raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`base-b-test-1-gpu-small (7)` fails on PRs whenever it lands on a smaller 5090 runner: `test/registered/hicache/test_hicache_storage.py` launches its server with `--hicache-size 100`, a fixed 100 GB pinned host pool, and on runners with roughly 51-81 GB of host memory the server is OOM-killed at launch:

```
CI_OFFLINE: Offline launch failed (Server process exited with code -9), retrying with online mode...
Exception: Server process exited with code -9. Check server logs for errors.
✗ FAILED: .../test/registered/hicache/test_hicache_storage.py returned exit code 5
```

The same shard passes when it draws a larger runner, so affected PRs only get through by rerunning until they do. It hit four unrelated PRs on 2026-10-16 (#44583, #44533, #44613, #44614).

## Modifications

On CUDA the test no longer passes `--hicache-size`. With neither `--hicache-size` nor `--hicache-ratio` set, the server uses the default host/device ratio and `--hicache-host-memory-fraction` (0.8 by default) reduces it until the host pools fit the machine's available memory, including the cgroup limit. The test still exercises the hierarchical cache with the `file` storage backend and the same MMLU threshold. ROCm keeps its explicit `--hicache-size 200`.

## Test plan

- `black`, `isort`, `ruff check --select=F401,F821,F823,UP037` clean on the changed file.
- Not run locally: the test's model (`meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`) is gated on the available machine, and its environment predates main's kernel requirements. This PR's own `base-b-test-1-gpu-small (7)` runs the test on the affected 5090 runners and is the validation.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:no_entry_sign: [Run #38891355502](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38891355502)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #38891355100](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38891355100)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:no_entry_sign: [Run #38891355239](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38891355239)<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

nodes.body:
Verified with `/rerun-test registered/hicache/test_hicache_storage.py` on this head (`ec5ba3641e`), [run 38950074179](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38950074179): passed on `5090-vast-es-0`, one of the ~52 GB 1-gpu-small runners where the fixed 100 GB pool fails today.

```
HiCache memory headroom: host 51.8 GiB, cgroup 51.5 GiB
Allocating kv hierarchical KV host pool: 106304 tokens, 13.93 GB host memory.
mmlu_score=0.66796875   (threshold 0.64)
```

On main the same runner class fails with `Not enough host memory available. Requesting 100.00 GB but only have 46.12 GB free` (seen this week on #44622, #44592 and others in `base-b-test-1-gpu-small (7)`).

detail.title: [CI] tests: Let test_hicache_storage size its host cache to the runner

files.patch:
@@ -37,8 +37,10 @@ def setUpClass(cls):
                 "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
                 "--mem-fraction-static",
                 0.7,
-                "--hicache-size",
-                100 if not _is_hip else 200,
+                # No fixed host-pool size on CUDA: the default ratio is
+                # reduced to fit the runner's memory (and cgroup limit), where
+                # a fixed 100 GB OOM-killed the server on smaller runners.
+                *(["--hicache-size", 200] if _is_hip else []),
                 "--page-size",
                 "64",
                 "--hicache-storage-backend",
